module: GE extension `core_vehicleActivePooling`: manages vehicle "pools" of which only a part is active (visible and simulated) at a time, to limit the load (traffic, parked vehicles...). A pool (class VehPool) keeps two lists (activeVehs, inactiveVehs), a maxActiveAmount limit, a distance mode (activation based on distance to the camera) and a mesh fade. A vehicle's active state is that of the object (`obj:setActive(0|1)`).
usage:
local pool = core_vehicleActivePooling.createPool({name = 'myTraffic', maxActiveAmount = 8})
pool:insertVeh(vehId)            -- adds a vehicle (active if the limit allows it)
pool.useDistanceMode = true      -- activates/deactivates based on distance to the camera
pool.activeDistance = 250
pool:cycle()                     -- deactivates the 1st active, activates the 1st inactive
notes: Pool fields: id, name, activeVehs (array of ids), inactiveVehs (array of ids), allVehs ([id] = 1 active / 0 inactive), fadeQueue ([id] = 1 fading in / 0 fading out), total, maxActiveAmount (math.huge by default), useSceneVehiclesCap (count all active vehicles of the scene instead of those of the pool), useDistanceMode (takes precedence over the other methods), updateActiveStatePostFade (change the active state after the fade), activeDistance (300 m), fadeDuration (0.25 s).
Active state changes go through obj:setActive, which triggers the onVehicleActiveChanged hook, which calls VehPool:_setVeh to keep the lists up to date.

Inconsistency: the module function deletePool(id) merely removes the pool from the table (no deletion of inactive vehicles, no onVehiclePoolRemoved hook), whereas VehPool:deletePool() deletes the inactive vehicles (except keepVehicles) and emits onVehiclePoolRemoved.

VehPool:getSceneActiveAmount(vehTypes) reads a vehTypes argument (list of types) that the automatic list does not report; nil = default types of getAllVehiclesByType, parked vehicles (isParked) excluded.
The signatures of several methods in the automatic list omit the first argument vehId (e.g. fadeVeh(vehId, dt)); the actual signatures are given below.

logErrors.desc: false by default; if true, warnings (vehicle already active, limit reached...) are logged.

createPool.desc: Creates a pool, registers it and emits onVehiclePoolAdded(id).

data.desc: {id?, name?, activeVehs?, inactiveVehs?, maxActiveAmount?}; name defaults to 'pool<id>'

deletePool.desc: Removes the pool from the pool table (without deleting vehicles or emitting a hook; see notes).

deleteAllPools.desc: Calls VehPool:deletePool() on each pool (deletes their inactive vehicles) then empties the table.

getPool.desc: Finds a pool by its name.

getPoolById.desc: Finds a pool by its id.

getPoolOfVeh.desc: Finds the pool containing a vehicle.

returns.desc: true if the vehicle is active in it

getAllPools.desc: Returns the table of all pools (not a copy).

onVehicleActiveChanged.desc: Hook: a vehicle's active state changes; updates the lists of all pools that contain it.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: a vehicle is destroyed; removes it from all pools.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook: end of the level; deletes all pools (deleteAllPools).

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: applies the distance mode (activateByDistanceTo) and advances the fadeQueue fades with dtSim / fadeDuration.

onSerialize.desc: Hook: serializes all pools before a Lua reload.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook: recreates the pools from the serialized data.

VehPool.desc: Vehicle pool created by createPool. Methods are called with `:` (pool:insertVeh(id)).

new.desc: Constructor (prefer createPool). Initializes lists, limits and default values, and guarantees a unique id.

onSerialize.desc: Returns the pool data to save.

onDeserialized.desc: Copies the fields of data into the pool.

getSceneActiveAmount.desc: Total number of active vehicles in the scene (all pools combined), parked vehicles excluded unless 'PropParked' is requested.

vehTypes.desc: vehicle types to count; nil = default

checkActiveLimit.desc: Returns true if the active vehicle limit is reached (counts the pool's active vehicles, or the scene's if useSceneVehiclesCap).

clearPool.desc: Empties all the pool's lists without touching the vehicles.

deletePool.desc: Deletes the pool; unless keepVehicles, also deletes the inactive vehicles. Emits onVehiclePoolRemoved(id).

cycle.desc: Deactivates an active vehicle and activates an inactive one from the same pool (the limit is ignored during the operation).

crossCycle.desc: Deactivates a vehicle of this pool and activates a vehicle of another pool.

otherPool.desc: other pool; nil or same pool = cycle

vehId1.desc: vehicle of this pool to deactivate

vehId2.desc: vehicle of the other pool to activate

fadeVeh.desc: Directly increases or decreases the alpha of the vehicle's meshes by `dt` (clamped 0..1). Use it every frame for a progressive fade.

vehId.desc: vehicle in the pool and active

returns.desc: new alpha, -1 if the vehicle is not in the pool or inactive

fadeInVeh.desc: Schedules a fade toward opaque. If the vehicle is inactive and updateActiveStatePostFade is true, activates it first.

fadeOutVeh.desc: Schedules a fade toward transparent (active vehicle required). With updateActiveStatePostFade, it is deactivated at the end of the fade.

tryInsertActiveVeh.desc: Checks whether one more active vehicle is allowed; with forceInsert, increases maxActiveAmount by 1 instead of refusing.

insertVeh.desc: Adds a vehicle to the pool; it is active if the object is active and the limit allows it, otherwise inactive (and deactivated via obj:setActive).

vehId.desc: existing vehicle, not already in this pool

removeVeh.desc: Removes a vehicle from the pool (without deleting it).

setAllVehs.desc: Activates (within the maxActiveAmount limit) or deactivates all vehicles of the pool.

activate.desc: true to activate, false to deactivate

returns.desc: true if at least one vehicle is concerned

_setVeh.desc: Internal: updates the lists when a vehicle's active state has changed (called by onVehicleActiveChanged). Do not call.

setVeh.desc: Activates or deactivates a vehicle of the pool while respecting the limit.

forceInsert.desc: raise the limit if it is reached

setMaxActiveAmount.desc: Sets the active vehicle limit and deactivates the excess if any.

activateByDistanceTo.desc: Deactivates active vehicles farther than dist + buffer and activates inactive ones closer than dist (the buffer avoids rapid toggling).

getVehs.desc: List of all pool ids (active first).
